LESSON: INDIGENOUS KENYAN INSTRUMENTAL ENSEMBLES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.3: Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can one play an instrument as part of an instrumental ensemble?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles
2. describe factors to consider when playing in an instrumental ensemble
3. appreciate the role of Kenyan indigenous musical instruments in performance

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: INDIGENOUS KENYAN INSTRUMENTAL ENSEMBLES
This lesson teaches Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles for Grade 6 CREATIVE ARTS.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe factors to consider when playing in an instrumental ensemble
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of Kenyan indigenous musical instruments in performance
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles above.
2. Explain Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can one play an instrument as part of an instrumental ensemble?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the categories of indigenous Kenyan instrumental ensembles
2. describe factors to consider when playing in an instrumental ensemble
3. appreciate the role of Kenyan indigenous musical instruments in performance
